purpose: Single-rule market-level trend filter on the liquid-universe equal-weight index. Research only. One primary rule, no tuning; sensitivities are descriptive and cannot make a candidate.

index.constituents: names with ADV20>=5,000,000 EGP and a close, evaluated at t-1 (ex-ante); daily return = equal-weight mean of per-name close-to-close returns of those names on day t
index.artefact_rule: per-name daily returns with |r|>11.5% (above the 10% exchange limit; splits/resumptions in RAW bars) are excluded from that day's mean, identically for strategy and benchmark; counts reported
index.start: first date with >=30 valid names; index level = cumulative product
index.caveat: daily-rebalanced equal-weight basket is a research index, not an investable product; rebalancing costs inside the invested period are not charged, for strategy and benchmark alike (optimistic)

rule.signal: index level L_t > simple mean of L over the last 200 sessions (needs 200 sessions)
rule.execution: signal at close t, trade at close t+1, exposure applies to returns from day t+2
rule.invested: 100% of the index when signal true, else 100% cash

costs: per switch side: fee 0.0018 + slippage 0.003 + mean over eligible names of 0.25*(250000/ADV20 at t-1). An entry at window start (if invested) costs one side. Benchmark buy-and-hold pays one entry side at window start.
benchmark: risk-matched hold: e * buy-and-hold monthly return, where e = fraction of days the strategy is invested in that window (tests timing skill beyond merely holding less); plain buy-and-hold also reported
warmup_note: data begins 2016-10-23, so the rule's 200-session history is first available around Aug 2017; discovery effectively starts then (actual start reported)
statistic: monthly d_m = timing net return - e*BH net return; mean d; 3-month-block bootstrap, 10000 draws, seed 20261106; lower bounds one-sided at 0.05 and 0.001
pass_rule: CANDIDATE_FOR_FORWARD_PAPER only if: discovery mean d>0 AND validation mean d>0 AND validation lower bound at 0.05 >0 AND validation max drawdown(timing) < max drawdown(buy-and-hold) AND validation months>=30. Strict gate (lb at 0.001>0) reported separately; project-wide multiplicity (>20 tests so far) means only the strict gate would support stronger claims. Nothing licenses an executable recommendation.
